decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - If during the course of the development additional contamination is discovered, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. Before the development is first brought into use the agreed scheme hereby approved shall be full implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
description: Details of contaminated land strategy submitted pursuant to Condition 14 (contaminated land Phase 1 desk study report) for planning permission 00707/DA/P6 dated the 13/03/12 for "the erection of three blocks comprising 13 x one, two and three bedroom dwellings with associated parking and landscaping".
